summary: Sparsentan has the strongest type of warning from the FDA for liver damage (hepatotoxicity) and harm to developing unborn babies (embryo-fetal toxicity) [4]. Because of the liver injury risks, it is only available through a special restricted enrollment program [4]. Warnings and precautions for this medicine also include low blood pressure (hypotension), sudden kidney damage, abnormally high blood potassium levels (hyperkalemia), and fluid retention [4]. In a small computer model rather than tests on people, it was given a medium score of 64 for liver harm and a low score of 39 for heart harm [M].
